pages.title: Derek Schmidt for Congress
pages.text:
Endorsed by President Trump
Proven Leader. Kansas Conservative.
## Derek Schmidt
Join Republican Derek Schmidt and let's bring common sense back to Kansas.
Derek Schmidt has spent his life serving Kansans. As Attorney General, he fought for Kansas every day. He sued President Biden and won. In Congress, he’ll continue to put Kansans first - every day.
Your support helps us tell his story and share our values.
## Endorsed By:
Former Florida Attorney General Pam Bondi
Former Governor Jeff Colyer
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton
Former U.S. Attorney General Matt Whitaker
Former Congressman Kevin Yoder
## Meet Derek Schmidt
A native of Independence, Derek Schmidt is the 5th generation of his family to call Kansas home.
The son and grandson of teachers, small business owners, metalworkers, miners and farmers, Derek learned early in life the value of hard work. He went on to earn his bachelor’s degree from the University of Kansas, his master’s degree from the University of Leicester in the United Kingdom, his law degree from Georgetown University, and his doctorate in law from the University of Kansas.
## Awards and Honors
- KANSAS SHERIFFS ASSOCIATION: Exceptional Service to Kansas Law Enforcement Award
- KANSAS CHILDREN'S SERVICE LEAGUE: Distinguished Service to Kansas Children Award
- NFIB KANSAS: Guardian of Small Business Award
- NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF ATTORNEYS GENERAL: Kelley-Wyman Award as the nation’s outstanding Attorney General for 2019
- WICHITA CRIME COMMISSION: Criminal Justice Professional of the Year Award
Elected the 44th attorney general for the State of Kansas, Derek made it his mission to serve and protect Kansans - especially the most vulnerable. He fought alongside Texas to secure the southern border of the United States, prosecuted criminals – including illegal aliens – who committed crimes in Kansas, and protected seniors and children from abuse.
Derek personally and successfully argued three cases for Kansas before the U.S. Supreme Court – including one to ensure Kansas could enforce state laws against illegal aliens - and won them all.
During the Obama administration, Derek was one of the attorneys general dubbed the ‘last line of defense” against illegal and overreaching federal actions, who helped pioneer the role of state attorneys general in using state litigation to fight back against federal overreach.
Derek previously served 10 years as a Kansas state senator, representing a rural district in Southeast Kansas. He served four of those years as chairman of the Senate Agriculture Committee and six as Senate Majority Leader.
Now a partner in one of the top 100 law firms in the country, Derek represents clients nationwide. He also enjoys spending time on his Southeast Kansas farm. He and his wife are the parents of two grown daughters.

## U.S. Representative for Kansas' 2nd Congressional district
Derek Schmidt is a fifth-generation Kansan who has spent his career standing tall for the values, safety, and prosperity of our state. Since taking office on January 3, 2025, Derek has hit the ground running in the 119th Congress, bringing his experience and love of Kansas to Washington to deliver real results for the people of the 2nd District.
## Delivering for the 2nd District
As your Representative, Derek's top priority is ensuring that Kansas has a strong voice in the nation's capital. Derek serves on three key House Committees where he works daily to protect Kansas interests:
- House Armed Services Committee: Advocating for our military installations at Fort Riley, Fort Leavenworth and Forbes Field, and ensuring our service members across the globe and the families who support them have the resources they need to keep America safe.
- House Judiciary Committee: Lending his legal expertise to secure the southern border, reform the federal bureaucracy, fight fraud and abuse of the taxpayers, and support law enforcement.
- House Small Business Committee: Protecting Kansas small businesses by ensuring they have the resources they need to grow and thrive.
## A Record of Conservative Leadership
Derek's work in Congress is a continuation of the Kansans First philosophy that defined his 12 years as Kansas Attorney General. As the state's chief legal officer, Derek personally and successfully argued three cases before the U.S. Supreme Court, stood up against federal overreach, and made protecting children and seniors his mission.
In Washington, he has remained a steadfast champion for:
- Border Security: Cosponsoring and passing the Laken Riley Act and Sarah's Law to ensure the safety of our communities from the consequences of the Biden-era border crisis.
- Economic Relief: Fighting to curb runaway federal spending, lower inflation, and extend tax relief for Kansas families, small businesses, and farmers and ranchers through the Working Families Tax Cut.
- Public Safety: Leading legislation to support victims of violent crime and coordinate the federal response to scams targeting our seniors, and backing legislation to deport fraudsters who are not U.S. citizens.
## Awards and Honors
- Kansas Hospital Association: 2025 Distinguished Health Care Advocate
- Growth Energy: 2025 Fueling Growth Award
- KANSAS SHERIFFS ASSOCIATION: Exceptional Service to Kansas Law Enforcement Award
- KANSAS CHILDREN'S SERVICE LEAGUE: Distinguished Service to Kansas Children Award
- NFIB KANSAS: Guardian of Small Business Award
- NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF ATTORNEYS GENERAL: Kelley-Wyman Award as the nation's outstanding Attorney General for 2019
- WICHITA CRIME COMMISSION: Criminal Justice Professional of the Year Award
## Deep Roots in the Sunflower State
A native of Independence, Derek learned the value of hard work from his family of teachers, farmers, laborers, and small business owners. He is a graduate of Independence High School and studied at Independence Community College before earning his bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas. He also holds a master's degree in international politics from the University of Leicester (UK), a law degree from Georgetown University, and a doctorate in law from the University of Kansas.
Derek and his wife, Jennifer, are the proud parents of two grown daughters. When he isn't in Washington or traveling across the 2nd District, Derek enjoys spending time on his farm in Southeast Kansas.
Derek Schmidt is honored to serve as your Representative. With your support, he will continue to fight for a stronger, safer, and more prosperous Kansas.
